text: With the recent turnover of Members and subsequent new appointments to the Toronto Preservation Board, it is necessary to elect a new Chair and Vice Chair, and it would be a good idea to do so in a timely manner.

The Toronto Preservation Board: 1. Elected Julia Rady as Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board, effective March 18, 2024 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed. 2. Elected Paul Cordingley as Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board, effective March 18, 2024 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed.
